children: Quantum-resistant EVM Layer 1 blockchain DAC said it has raised $1 million from Unicorn Crypto Ventures. According to ChainCatcher, DAC is building EVM-compatible blockchain infrastructure designed to resist quantum computing attacks.

The project said it is based on a Quadrans fork and uses a three-layer node architecture and PoQW consensus. It also uses a dual-asset model, DACT and DACC, to support ecosystem activity and transaction execution for developers and enterprises.

title: Quantum-Resistant EVM Layer 1 DAC Raises $1 Million
